name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
headline: CRM & Field Operations Scheduling Coordinator
summary: Operations coordinator with 15+ years managing client schedules, onboarding calendars, and CRM-driven service workflows in fast-moving, deadline-driven environments. Built and ran the appointment-booking, confirmation, reminder, and no-show-recovery systems that electrical, HVAC, and plumbing trade businesses use to keep field work on schedule. Coordinated 25+ client onboarding launches a month at peak volume and reprioritized daily workloads across concurrent engagements when timelines shifted.

experience.title: CRM & Scheduling Systems Architect — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel scheduling and automation system — 20+ workflows — covering lead capture and routing, appointment booking with confirmation and reminders, no-show recovery, and post-service follow-up, built specifically for electrical, plumbing, and HVAC trade businesses.
Architect and implement CRM systems in GoHighLevel (primary) and HubSpot, including contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and lead/appointment routing logic, with strict data-hygiene protocols.
Managed up to 3 concurrent client engagements at peak, coordinating competing priorities and deadlines while personally building and running each client's operational systems.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping schedules and project records auditable across concurrent engagements.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network spanning health, home services, and retail verticals, coordinating rollout schedules and driving rapid adoption.
Onboarded and managed 15–20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K–$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated training sequences that reduced onboarding friction and kept partners informed of status and next steps.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, coordinating campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years — a team of 20, later a team of 8 — overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
Carried a combined sales and implementation load in year two, after the role expanded from a primarily sales focus in year one.
Led onboarding and launch operations as team lead and primary strategic contact, delivering launches on time and accelerating time-to-value.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute against.
Guided onboarding alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting workflow design and resolving technical challenges during setup.
Escalated issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk with direct strategic guidance.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
